comparisons.peer_topic: AI Software Ecosystem and Silo AI Acquisition
comparisons.peer_summary: To support its AI strategy, AMD consolidated AI teams to develop a comprehensive software ecosystem, improved AMD ROCm software performance, and acquired Silo AI Oy to accelerate AI model development and deployment on AMD hardware, leveraging Silo's software stack for training large language models.
comparisons.comparison: While AVGO defines its business via formal reportable segments (Semiconductor Solutions and Infrastructure Software), AMD discusses its strategic organization around AI and data center capabilities. AMD consolidated AI teams to develop a comprehensive software ecosystem, similar to how AVGO structures its Infrastructure Software segment to cover cloud and edge solutions. Both highlight software ecosystem development as a key strategic pillar within their broader hardware/software business models.

sentences.text: Our infrastructure software segment includes our private and hybrid cloud, application development and delivery, software-defined edge, application networking and security, mainframe, distributed and cybersecurity solutions, and our FC SAN business.
To execute our AI strategy, we brought together multiple AI teams across AMD to drive development of a comprehensive software ecosystem spanning our full product portfolio.
